// diagnostic

E2811

`app.images` setting `{setting}` is not written as a literal.

What

`app.images` setting `{setting}` is not written as a literal.

Why

The image variants are facts of the application graph, which is read from the source before the app runs, so each setting must be known there.

Fix

Write `{setting}:` as a literal, such as `formats: [.JPEG]`, `widths: [640, 1280]`, `quality: 80` or `enabled: false`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2811: tests/ui/web_app_images_setting_not_literal.stderr.

Error [jet.ImageSettingNotLiteral]: `app.images` setting `quality` is not written as a literal.
  --> tests/ui/web_app_images_setting_not_literal.jet:5:39
    |
  5 | run: fn() { web.app().images(quality: level()).serve() }
    |                                       ^^^^^
 Why: The image variants are facts of the application graph, which is read from the source before the app runs, so each setting must be known there.
 Fix: Write `quality:` as a literal, such as `formats: [.JPEG]`, `widths: [640, 1280]`, `quality: 80` or `enabled: false`.
